summary: First-run testing of ReCircuit (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Full backend + frontend suite executed. 25/25 pytest backend cases pass. All targeted frontend flows (splash, home, collector login + new-listing wizard w/ auto-categorize + estimate + publish, recycler register + match + Stripe checkout redirect, admin overview + logs + users, role gating, unauth guard) pass.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> injected as child of <option> inside category <select> (data-ve-dynamic instrumentation). Non-blocking but pollutes console.

action_items: Optional: silence the <option><span> hydration warning on the New Listing category select (StepCategorize.jsx line ~38). Consider rendering plain option label text without the dynamic-instrumentation span wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: httpOnly cookie is set with SameSite=None; Secure=True — good for cross-site preview but requires HTTPS (satisfied).

routes.py finalize_payment relies on ObjectId(txn['listing_id']) — payment_transactions stores listing_id as string; conversion is fine, but ensure ObjectId validity is guaranteed (currently is, since we insert str(_id)).
routes.py listing_detail role check: for status='open', any authenticated user can view (intentional). OK.
seed.py idempotency: guards new listings via 'seeded' flag; will also refresh admin/demo passwords if changed — matches playbook expectation.
Consider rate-limit info in login response (X-RateLimit) — currently only 429 after 5 fails; acceptable.
No pagination on /admin/logs and /admin/users (500-doc cap). Fine for MVP.
test_credentials: Using seeded creds from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (admin/collector/recycler). Verified working.
seed_data_creation: Registered a few TEST_ prefixed collector/recycler users and TEST-titled listings via API + UI during flow tests. No production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_recircuit_api.py — set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before running pytest. Stripe redirect verified only by host (checkout.stripe.com) as instructed; do not attempt to complete payment. Seeded recycler had a 'matched' pending payment lot — one paid seeded lot exists which was used for handover test (now completed). If handover test needs a rerun, may need reseeding.
